title: AI Model Groupthink
title_zh: 人工智能模型群体思维

paragraphs.en: Ask multiple AI models for a comparable opinion, and Chinese models seem to be more likely to respond in line with the wider consensus .
paragraphs.zh: 询问多个 AI 模型以获得可比较的意见时，中国的模型似乎更有可能给出符合更广泛共识的回答。

paragraphs.en: I recently built/vibed a small web tool that asks a panel of 12 AI models any kind of “top three” question and tallies the answers like an Olympic medal table. The idea is to have a quick way to fetch hivemind recommendations on anything from a good book to read, things to do in a city, or a low-stakes purchase.
paragraphs.zh: 我最近搭建/试做了一个小型网络工具，它可以向 12 个 AI 模型组成的评审团提出任何“前三名”式的问题，并像奥运会奖牌榜一样统计答案。 这个想法是为了提供一种快速获取“群体智慧”推荐的方式，无论是值得阅读的好书、某个城市里值得做的事情，还是低风险的小额购物，都可以用它来征求意见。

sents.en: I recently built/vibed a small web tool that asks a panel of 12 AI models any kind of “top three” question and tallies the answers like an Olympic medal table.
sents.zh: 我最近搭建/试做了一个小型网络工具，它可以向 12 个 AI 模型组成的评审团提出任何“前三名”式的问题，并像奥运会奖牌榜一样统计答案。

sents.en: The idea is to have a quick way to fetch hivemind recommendations on anything from a good book to read, things to do in a city, or a low-stakes purchase.
sents.zh: 这个想法是为了提供一种快速获取“群体智慧”推荐的方式，无论是值得阅读的好书、某个城市里值得做的事情，还是低风险的小额购物，都可以用它来征求意见。

paragraphs.en: The system prompt is simple and built around this request:
paragraphs.zh: 系统提示词很简单，围绕此请求构建：

paragraphs.en: You are answering a ranking question with your own independent opinion . Give your top 3 answers, ranked from 1 (best) to 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 你正在凭借自己的独立观点回答一个排序问题。 给出你的前 3 个答案，按第 1 名（最佳）到第 3 名排序。

sents.en: You are answering a ranking question with your own independent opinion .
sents.zh: 你正在凭借自己的独立观点回答一个排序问题。

sents.en: Give your top 3 answers, ranked from 1 (best) to 3 .
sents.zh: 给出你的前 3 个答案，按第 1 名（最佳）到第 3 名排序。

paragraphs.en: The call explicitly asks each model for its own view, not to guess what the crowd thinks.
paragraphs.zh: 这次调用明确要求每个模型给出自己的观点，而不是去猜测群体的想法。

paragraphs.en: There is some normalization required: if we ask for the best castles in Ireland and Luna votes “Rock of Cashel” while Gemini votes “Cashel Rock”, we want to treat that as a consensus. The app uses Gemini Flash to adjudicate this.
paragraphs.zh: 这里需要做一些规范化处理：如果我们询问爱尔兰最好的城堡，Luna 投票「卡舍尔岩城」，而 Gemini 投票「卡舍尔之岩」，我们希望把这两个答案视为一致。 该应用使用 Gemini Flash 来对此进行裁决。

sents.en: There is some normalization required: if we ask for the best castles in Ireland and Luna votes “Rock of Cashel” while Gemini votes “Cashel Rock”, we want to treat that as a consensus.
sents.zh: 这里需要做一些规范化处理：如果我们询问爱尔兰最好的城堡，Luna 投票「卡舍尔岩城」，而 Gemini 投票「卡舍尔之岩」，我们希望把这两个答案视为一致。

sents.en: The app uses Gemini Flash to adjudicate this.
sents.zh: 该应用使用 Gemini Flash 来对此进行裁决。

paragraphs.en: A word on reading the chart. Long bars and a winner at the top make it look like a leaderboard, as if more consensus is better. It isn’t necessarily. However, having clicked around a few of the queries: outlier responses are more likely to be interesting than to be an insightfully correct response that bests the responses of all the other models. I like that Gemini recommends you paint an adult bedroom terracotta while all the other models recommend green, cream, and greige, but I understand that many people will want their bots to stick to the cultural mainstream thank you very much.
paragraphs.zh: 关于如何阅读这张图表说几句。 长条形加上顶部有个“赢家”，让它看起来像个排行榜，仿佛共识越多越好。其实未必。 不过，在点击查看了一些查询之后：离群（outlier）的回答往往更有趣，而不是那种比所有其他模型的回答都更胜一筹、洞察正确的高明回答。 我很欣赏 Gemini 建议把成人卧室刷成赤陶色，而所有其他模型都推荐绿色、奶油色和灰米色，但我也理解，很多人就是希望他们的机器人坚守文化主流，多谢好意了。

sents.zh: 我很欣赏 Gemini 建议把成人卧室刷成赤陶色，而所有其他模型都推荐绿色、奶油色和灰米色，但我也理解，很多人就是希望他们的机器人坚守文化主流，多谢好意了。

paragraphs.en: Each model is scored against the consensus of the other eleven, getting full credit for the right item in the right podium spot and half credit for the right item in the wrong spot. A score of 1.0 would mean perfect agreement with the winning conclusions of the rest of the group; 0 would mean total contrarianism.
paragraphs.zh: 每个模型的评分依据是与其他十一个模型的共识，在正确的领奖台位置上给出正确项目得满分，在错误位置上给出正确项目得一半分。 得分 1.0 意味着与组内其余成员的获胜结论完全一致；0 则意味着完全唱反调。

sents.en: Each model is scored against the consensus of the other eleven, getting full credit for the right item in the right podium spot and half credit for the right item in the wrong spot.
sents.zh: 每个模型的评分依据是与其他十一个模型的共识，在正确的领奖台位置上给出正确项目得满分，在错误位置上给出正确项目得一半分。

sents.en: A score of 1.0 would mean perfect agreement with the winning conclusions of the rest of the group; 0 would mean total contrarianism.
sents.zh: 得分 1.0 意味着与组内其余成员的获胜结论完全一致；0 则意味着完全唱反调。

paragraphs.en: The top four conformists are all Chinese: DeepSeek, Kimi K2, Tencent’s Hy3 and GLM.
paragraphs.zh: 排名前四的“随大流者”都是中国的：DeepSeek、Kimi K2、腾讯的 Hy3 和 GLM。

paragraphs.en: Group the scores by country and the gap holds. The five Chinese models average 0.47, the six American models 0.38, and Europe’s lone entrant, Mistral, scores 0.36.
paragraphs.zh: 按国家对这些得分进行分组，差距依然存在。 五个中国模型平均得分为0.47，六个美国模型为0.38，而欧洲唯一的参赛者Mistral得分为0.36。

sents.en: Group the scores by country and the gap holds.
sents.zh: 按国家对这些得分进行分组，差距依然存在。

sents.en: The five Chinese models average 0.47, the six American models 0.38, and Europe’s lone entrant, Mistral, scores 0.36.
sents.zh: 五个中国模型平均得分为0.47，六个美国模型为0.38，而欧洲唯一的参赛者Mistral得分为0.36。

paragraphs.en: The exception is Qwen, Alibaba’s model, which scores 0.38 and sits among the American models, just behind Grok and Nemotron (both 0.40). At the other end, the two most contrarian models are Meta’s Llama 4 Scout (0.34) and Anthropic’s Claude Haiku (0.32).
paragraphs.zh: 例外是阿里巴巴的 Qwen 模型，得分 0.38，位于美国模型之中，紧随 Grok 和 Nemotron（均为 0.40）之后。 在另一端，两个最特立独行的模型是 Meta 的 Llama 4 Scout（0.34）和 Anthropic 的 Claude Haiku（0.32）。

sents.en: The exception is Qwen, Alibaba’s model, which scores 0.38 and sits among the American models, just behind Grok and Nemotron (both 0.40).
sents.zh: 例外是阿里巴巴的 Qwen 模型，得分 0.38，位于美国模型之中，紧随 Grok 和 Nemotron（均为 0.40）之后。

sents.en: At the other end, the two most contrarian models are Meta’s Llama 4 Scout (0.34) and Anthropic’s Claude Haiku (0.32).
sents.zh: 在另一端，两个最特立独行的模型是 Meta 的 Llama 4 Scout（0.34）和 Anthropic 的 Claude Haiku（0.32）。

paragraphs.en: I don’t know. Here are some explanations I find plausible, roughly in order.
paragraphs.zh: 我不知道。 以下是我认为较为合理的一些解释，大致按顺序排列。

sents.en: I don’t know.
sents.zh: 我不知道。

sents.en: Here are some explanations I find plausible, roughly in order.
sents.zh: 以下是我认为较为合理的一些解释，大致按顺序排列。

paragraphs.en: Distillation means training a model on another model’s outputs, essentially a cloning technique. US labs, including OpenAI and Anthropic, have publicly accused Chinese labs of distilling their models at scale. Earlier this year Anthropic named DeepSeek and Kimi-maker Moonshot (and also MiniMax, which is not represented in the sample here) as running large distillation campaigns against Claude. That does not establish that distillation caused the pattern here, or even that these models were trained that way. But if a model was trained heavily on outputs from other models, one expected outcome is that its preferences converge with those of source models, especially when they converge. A model built that way is partly a consensus machine. It is striking that DeepSeek and Kimi, first and second in the table, are among the labs most often named in those accusations.
paragraphs.zh: 蒸馏指的是用另一个模型的输出来训练模型，本质上是一种克隆技术。 包括 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 在内的美国实验室曾公开指控中国实验室大规模蒸馏他们的模型。 今年早些时候，Anthropic 点名 DeepSeek 和 Kimi 的开发方月之暗面（还有 MiniMax，但其未出现在本样本中），称它们对 Claude 进行了大规模蒸馏。 这并不能证明蒸馏造成了这里观察到的模式，甚至不能证明这些模型是以这种方式训练的。 但如果一个模型大量使用其他模型的输出进行训练，一个可预期的结果是它的偏好会与源模型的偏好趋同，尤其是在源模型彼此趋同的情况下。 以这种方式构建的模型，在某种程度上是一台共识机器。 值得注意的是，在表格中排名第一和第二的 DeepSeek 和 Kimi，其开发方正是那些指控中被点名最多的实验室之一。

sents.zh: 蒸馏指的是用另一个模型的输出来训练模型，本质上是一种克隆技术。

paragraphs.en: The Chinese open-weight ecosystem is tightly knit. Labs release weights, publish methods and train on synthetic data produced by each other’s models. That could be giving the five Chinese models a family resemblance.
paragraphs.zh: 中国的开源权重生态系统联系紧密。 各实验室发布模型权重、公开训练方法，并使用彼此模型生成的合成数据进行训练。 这可能正是这五个中国模型呈现出家族相似性的原因。

sents.en: The Chinese open-weight ecosystem is tightly knit.
sents.zh: 中国的开源权重生态系统联系紧密。

sents.en: Labs release weights, publish methods and train on synthetic data produced by each other’s models.
sents.zh: 各实验室发布模型权重、公开训练方法，并使用彼此模型生成的合成数据进行训练。

sents.en: That could be giving the five Chinese models a family resemblance.
sents.zh: 这可能正是这五个中国模型呈现出家族相似性的原因。

paragraphs.en: This matters because of how the score works. Five of the twelve models here are Chinese, so if they share a style, they help build the consensus they are scored against. A bloc that votes together will always look conformist. (Qwen breaking from the bloc is a point against this, or at least a sign the family isn’t that close.)
paragraphs.zh: 这很重要，因为评分机制的工作方式如此。 这里十二个模型中有五个是中国模型，所以如果它们共享一种风格，就会帮助构建它们被评分所依据的共识。 一个集体投票的阵营看起来总是会显得随大流。 （Qwen 脱离了这个阵营，这一点反驳了上述说法，或者至少表明这个系列并没有那么紧密。）

sents.en: This matters because of how the score works.
sents.zh: 这很重要，因为评分机制的工作方式如此。

sents.en: Five of the twelve models here are Chinese, so if they share a style, they help build the consensus they are scored against.
sents.zh: 这里十二个模型中有五个是中国模型，所以如果它们共享一种风格，就会帮助构建它们被评分所依据的共识。

sents.en: A bloc that votes together will always look conformist.

sents.zh: （Qwen 脱离了这个阵营，这一点反驳了上述说法，或者至少表明这个系列并没有那么紧密。）

paragraphs.en: The bottom of the table is crowded with smaller, cheaper models: Llama 4 Scout, Claude Haiku and Mistral Small. Smaller models hold less of the shared cultural canon in memory, so their picks are more scattered. Gemini Flash-Lite and DeepSeek’s Flash model are counter-examples, so size can’t be the whole story.
paragraphs.zh: 表格底部挤满了规模更小、价格更低的模型：Llama 4 Scout、Claude Haiku 和 Mistral Small。 较小的模型记忆中存储的共同文化经典较少，因此它们的选择更加分散。 Gemini Flash-Lite 和 DeepSeek 的 Flash 模型却是反例，所以模型大小并不能解释全部问题。

sents.en: The bottom of the table is crowded with smaller, cheaper models: Llama 4 Scout, Claude Haiku and Mistral Small.
sents.zh: 表格底部挤满了规模更小、价格更低的模型：Llama 4 Scout、Claude Haiku 和 Mistral Small。

sents.en: Smaller models hold less of the shared cultural canon in memory, so their picks are more scattered.
sents.zh: 较小的模型记忆中存储的共同文化经典较少，因此它们的选择更加分散。

sents.en: Gemini Flash-Lite and DeepSeek’s Flash model are counter-examples, so size can’t be the whole story.
sents.zh: Gemini Flash-Lite 和 DeepSeek 的 Flash 模型却是反例，所以模型大小并不能解释全部问题。

paragraphs.en: About half of new text appearing on crawl-worthy URLs is written by humans, and half by AI. A model trained more recently has read more of the slop. Most of the Chinese models here are mid-2026 releases. Again there are counter-examples: Kimi (knowledge through 2024-12) is second, while Luna has the newest cutoff on the panel and sits ninth.
paragraphs.zh: 在可被抓取的网址上新出现的文本中，大约一半由人类撰写，一半由 AI 生成。 训练时间更近的模型读过更多这类垃圾内容。 这里的中文模型大多是 2026 年年中发布的。 同样也存在反例：Kimi（知识截止于 2024 年 12 月）排名第二，而 Luna 拥有该组中最新的知识截止时间，却排在第九。

sents.en: About half of new text appearing on crawl-worthy URLs is written by humans, and half by AI.
sents.zh: 在可被抓取的网址上新出现的文本中，大约一半由人类撰写，一半由 AI 生成。

sents.en: A model trained more recently has read more of the slop.
sents.zh: 训练时间更近的模型读过更多这类垃圾内容。

sents.en: Most of the Chinese models here are mid-2026 releases.
sents.zh: 这里的中文模型大多是 2026 年年中发布的。

sents.en: Again there are counter-examples: Kimi (knowledge through 2024-12) is second, while Luna has the newest cutoff on the panel and sits ninth.
sents.zh: 同样也存在反例：Kimi（知识截止于 2024 年 12 月）排名第二，而 Luna 拥有该组中最新的知识截止时间，却排在第九。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps US labs are investing in post-training in a way that gives more distinctive character, more willingness to pick the less obvious answer. If there’s a trade-off between personality and benchmark-maxxing that may also play into the flipside, where the Chinese labs are plausibly focusing more on hitting benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 或许美国实验室正以一种赋予模型更鲜明个性、更愿意选择不那么显而易见的答案的方式投资后训练。 如果个性与刷榜之间存在权衡，这也可能是另一面的一部分——中国实验室可能更专注于冲刺基准测试成绩。

sents.zh: 或许美国实验室正以一种赋予模型更鲜明个性、更愿意选择不那么显而易见的答案的方式投资后训练。

sents.en: If there’s a trade-off between personality and benchmark-maxxing that may also play into the flipside, where the Chinese labs are plausibly focusing more on hitting benchmarks.
sents.zh: 如果个性与刷榜之间存在权衡，这也可能是另一面的一部分——中国实验室可能更专注于冲刺基准测试成绩。

paragraphs.en: All prompts are in English. A model whose English training data leans on the most widely syndicated sources would tend to give the most canonical English-language answers, which is exactly what consensus rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 所有提示词均为英文。 一个模型的英文训练数据若偏重最广泛分发的内容来源，就会倾向于给出最标准的英文答案，而这正是共识机制所奖励的。

sents.zh: 所有提示词均为英文。

paragraphs.en: Which of these is more correct, and which is behavior we want to encourage? I suspect most of us want an AI ecosystem that isn’t a groupthink borg. We like a bit of Temperature. We want models to disagree, surprise us, occasionally push for the terracotta bedroom. I also suspect that, as users, we tend to reward models that give us answers that feel safe. These two instincts are going to be pulled apart by a lot of money over the next few years.
paragraphs.zh: 哪一种更正确，哪一种又是我们想要鼓励的行为？ 我猜想，我们大多数人都希望AI生态系统不是一群群体思维的蜂巢。 我们喜欢一点「温度」。 我们希望模型能提出不同意见、给我们带来惊喜，偶尔还坚持推荐那个赤陶色的卧室。 我还猜想，作为用户，我们往往更青睐那些给出让我们感觉安全的答案的模型。 在未来几年里，这两种本能将被大量金钱撕扯开来。

sents.zh: 我还猜想，作为用户，我们往往更青睐那些给出让我们感觉安全的答案的模型。

sents.en: These two instincts are going to be pulled apart by a lot of money over the next few years.
sents.zh: 在未来几年里，这两种本能将被大量金钱撕扯开来。

paragraphs.en: Multiply this out to millions of users seeking suggestions and it becomes something bigger: a quiet, constant pressure towards a lab-mediated consensus middle.
paragraphs.zh: 将其放大到数百万寻求建议的用户，这就变成了更大的东西：一种朝着由实验室中介的共识中间地带的、持续而安静的压力。

paragraphs.en: Commercially, being included in that consensus middle is already lucrative. For two decades companies have poured huge amounts of capital into efforts to rank well in search engines (SEO), and the smart ones have already switched to competing over placement in AI responses (AIO/GEO). Self-reinforcing loops will escalate the value of this prize. If the labs are competitively exfiltrating each other’s responses, getting a product highly placed in one model’s answers could enable it to flow into the next model’s training data, and the next. Consensus that was gamed once can be copied until it looks like a fact about the world.
paragraphs.zh: 在商业上，被纳入那个共识性的中间地带本身就已利润丰厚。 二十年来，企业投入巨额资金力争在搜索引擎中获得靠前的排名（SEO），而聪明的企业已经转向争夺在 AI 回复中的位置（AIO/GEO）。 自我强化的循环将不断抬高这一奖赏的价值。 如果各家实验室在竞争性地相互提取对方的回复，那么让某个产品出现在一个模型答案的靠前位置，可能使其流入下一个模型的训练数据，再流入再下一个模型。 被操纵过一次的共识可以被不断复制，直到它看起来像是关于世界的一个事实。

sents.en: Consensus that was gamed once can be copied until it looks like a fact about the world.
sents.zh: 被操纵过一次的共识可以被不断复制，直到它看起来像是关于世界的一个事实。

paragraphs.en: Paint colours are a harmless starting point, but the same machinery will answer questions about which candidate to trust, which news source is reliable, which history is true. Decorating recommendations are obviously not equivalent to political or factual judgments, and models may behave very differently across domains, but the same basic machinery increasingly mediates all of them. When the models are copying each other’s opinions and feeding those opinions back into the real world, a consensus doesn’t need to be right. It only needs to be first.
paragraphs.zh: 油漆颜色推荐是一个无害的起点，但同样的机制也会回答关于该信任哪位候选人、哪个新闻来源可靠、哪种历史叙述属实的问题。 装修建议显然不等同于政治或事实判断，模型在不同领域的表现也可能大不相同，但同样的基本机制正日益成为这一切的中介。 当各个模型在互相复制彼此的观点，并把这些观点反馈到现实世界中时，共识并不需要是正确的。 它只需要抢先出现就够了。

paragraphs.en: For more decorating or political advice, you can ask the robots for recommendations here .
paragraphs.zh: 如需更多装修或政治方面的建议，你可以在此处向机器人寻求推荐。

paragraphs.en: Implementation notes: The twelve models were called through OpenRouter, mostly in their cheaper “flash” or small variants, with reasoning switched off where the provider allows it. “Default” means the model was run with whatever reasoning behaviour the provider ships. I did not touch the Temperature parameter, nor did I explore what defaults the different models use.
paragraphs.zh: 实现说明：这十二个模型通过 OpenRouter 调用，大多使用其较便宜的「flash」或小型变体，并在提供商允许的情况下关闭了推理功能。「默认」表示模型以提供商自带的推理行为运行。 我没有改动 Temperature 参数，也没有探究不同模型所使用的默认值。
